## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `2c776b47c83a08b682b577948ac6f4e9a895bf77`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #35689 body and all six comments (triage 7025512457, seat 4 claim 7073322916, os-dev-report 7075348874, handover 7075542258, seat 7 claim 7075957369); PR #36332 body, its 16-file list and the net diff against merge-base `99fbaa6d` (the PR's diff equals `git diff 99fbaa6d..2c776b47`, 16 files, 259+ 3-); the 58 check-runs on the head: 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure, 0 in progress (Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Type Check UI, Test UI 1-16/16, Lint UI, Build and E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Lint and Repo Gates all success). Face: declaration (no published schema, no governed path in the tree; `.changeset/` and `ui/packages/**` only).

### ① Derived judgments

- `@object-ui/i18n`, named right: one new key `table.cellSavedAnnouncement` in all eleven packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant; every pack in `src/locales/`), each carrying the `{{fields}}` slot. Through `./locales` and `./locales/*` this also widens the exported `TranslationKeys` (`typeof en`) by one readonly member; additive, nothing removed or renamed.
- `@object-ui/components`, no export added or removed: `TABLE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` is module-private (its new fallback uses the `{{fields}}` spelling `interpolateFallback` reads); `CellEditButton` is not exported; no prop of `DataTableSchema` or `GridCellSelection` changes shape. The DOM the table draws changes, and the changeset names each change: `aria-readonly` on grid data cells and on the type-catcher, one `data-slot="cell-save-announcer"` polite region when `autosaves`, the cell save mark moving from `role="status"` to `role="img"`, and a touch click on an unselected cell's edit button editing nothing. The table-facts arm (`!isEditable`) and `readOnlyReasonOf`'s own arm read the same four facts (`editable`, `col.editable`, `col.masked`, `rowMayEdit`), so the two arms agree outside the host's facts.
- Card acceptance against the diff: touch tap opens the record and never edits (held on main, pinned; the edit-button gap fixed); read-only said on the cell a reader moves to (selected cell, host facts; see S1, S2); save result said in one persistent region, failure once by the existing cell alert; picker focus return and checked-rows-edit-one-cell held on main and pinned; contrast readings in the body, no change. Slice B (group move, subtotals, footer total) is out of this PR by the card's split and stays on the card (`Part of #35689`, right).
- S1 (should-fix) — the diff breaks the written contract of a published interface without amending it or naming it. `GridCellSelection.describeCell` (exported from `@object-ui/components`, `context/gridCellSelection.tsx:101`) says "asked when the reader acts on it, never per render", and the new `cellReadOnly` (`data-table.tsx:5190-5191`) calls `readOnlyReasonOf`, so `describeCell`, on every render of the table for the selected cell. The PR's own justification for using the table facts on other cells is that same contract, so the code argues from it while not keeping it. The one in-tree host (`ObjectGrid.tsx:1376`) is render-safe (pure reads), so nothing breaks today, but a third-party host built to the jsdoc may not be. Fix either way: read it at the act (compute the selected cell's read-only answer when the cell becomes selected, where `onCellSelect` already runs, and keep it in state), or amend the jsdoc to "asked of the selected cell on each render, and of any cell when the reader acts on it" and name that change in the changeset.
- S2 (should-fix) — the selected cell's `aria-readonly` can miss an approval lock, though the PR body names "approval lock" among the facts it reads. `useRowApprovalLocks` keeps answers in a ref (`useRowApprovalLocks.ts:51`, set inside the async `probe`) and never re-renders when one arrives; `probe` runs from `onCellSelect` on that same select. So on the first cell selected in a row whose lock is only known from the server read (not from `row.approval_status`), the render that sets `aria-readonly` sees `asking`, the answer lands with no re-render, and a screen reader hears no "read only" until selection moves. Enter or F2 still says the reason (`attemptEdit` reads it fresh), so nothing is written. Fix by re-rendering when a lock answer lands (a version state in the hook, `plugin-grid`, inside the card's file surface), or else narrow the acceptance note to say the server lock is said on the next move.
- N1 (nit) — `CellEditButton` onClick comment says the tap "opens the record", but the row's click handler ignores clicks on buttons (the PR's own acceptance note), so a hybrid-device tap on a button drawn earlier for a mouse does nothing. Fix the comment. A dead tap is acceptable as a rare edge. Separately, `pressedByRef` is never reset, so a later click whose `pointerType` is empty (an assistive-tech or synthetic activation) after an earlier touch press is swallowed too. Clearing the ref in onClick would fix it.
- N2 (nit) — the announcement joins column names with a hard-coded `', '` (`data-table.tsx:3445`), so ja, zh-Hans and zh-Hant read a Latin comma inside their own sentence when one save sends several cells. A column whose header is not a string is announced by its raw `accessorKey` (the same fallback the catcher's `aria-label` already uses).

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/35689-inline-edit-a11y.md`: `'@object-ui/components': patch`, `'@object-ui/i18n': patch`. The two packages are exactly the ones the diff moves. `Metadata-protocol: none` is true (nothing a metadata author can write changes; no `packages/spec` path), so AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3 gives `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. Right.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is in both the PR body and the changeset body, line-initial, a well-formed arm. It is true for the i18n key: seat 4's report measured `dist/locales/en.d.ts` declaring it, and the source confirms it. The "nothing narrowed" half holds for accept sets and exports. The one host-facing semantic change is the `describeCell` call timing (S1), which is undeclared: resolved by keeping the contract, no declaration change is owed; resolved by amending the jsdoc, the changeset should name it. No `(narrowing)` arm, no BREAKING banner and no ADR-0087 disposition are owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in the os-dev-report (7075348874); nothing to answer.
- `out_of_scope_findings` (one, `carrier: none`), answered. (a) `aria-readonly` on unselected cells reads only the table's facts. Accepted as a trade-off: in the select-first grid the screen reader's focus is the selected cell, and it reads the host's facts, so the acceptance line holds for a moving reader. Browse mode hears an implied "editable" on a host-read-only column it does not select. That is acknowledged in the PR's acceptance notes and needs no carrier, subject to S1's resolution. (b) The hybrid dead tap: accepted (see N1).
- Deviations (1) to (5): (4), the Clause-② amendment from the claim's `no` to `yes (widening)`, is verified right above. (5), CI not driven at hand-over, is settled: every check-run on the head is now success or skipped. (1) to (3) are process choices outside this contract review.
- Not tested on a real device: VoiceOver/NVDA output and a real iPad. Stated in the PR, jsdom pins only. That is the card's acceptance medium, so it stays for the L1/L2 seats or a dogfood pass, not this record.
- N3 (nit) — seat 7's claim (7075957369) gives `File surface: ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/` and a plugin-grid Responsibility line, but the diff's code is in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` (seat 4's claimed surface, handed over unchanged). PR-body guards are green. Worth aligning the claim if seat 7 pushes again, for example for S2.
- SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5): the diff adds no data access, no id materialisation and no in-app join (UI rendering, ARIA attributes and locale strings only). No finding.

## 席位核对

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36332` CLEAN(13 项无标记);draft、base `main`、`Part of #35689`(A 部分;B 部分留卡,首行与正文里卡号旁都没有闭合动词);16 个文件 +259 −3。门禁 check-runs @ `2c776b47`:45 success · 13 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending。
- 已核属实:触屏不在未选中格里画编辑按钮,之前为鼠标画出的按钮被手指点到也不编辑(`CellEditButton`);整张表只有一个常驻的 `aria-live="polite"` 区域,用 `seq` 当 key 保证同一句话说两次;失败时清空区域;单元格的保存标记从 `role="status"` 改成 `role="img"`;只在 `role="grid"`(`keyboardNavigation`,含 select-first)时加 `aria-readonly`;新键 `table.cellSavedAnnouncement` 在 11 个包里都有译文,无与 en 相同的值。changeset 三段与 diff 逐句相符。三处消融各自让对应用例变红,读数在正文里。

## 要改的一项

1. **本 PR 让一个已发布接口的 TSDoc 变成假话。** `@object-ui/components` 的 `GridCellSelection.describeCell` 声明为 "asked when the reader acts on it, never per render"(`ui/packages/components/src/context/gridCellSelection.tsx:101`)。本 PR 的 `cellReadOnly` 在渲染时对选中格调用 `readOnlyReasonOf` → `factsOf` → `describeCell`,也就是选中格在表格每次渲染时都会被问一次。L1 清单规定:本轮让已发布声明变假的必须在本轮修。两种改法任选一种:
   - (a) 不在渲染里问:在选中格变化时(`onCellSelect` 那一刻,或选中格坐标变化的 effect 里)问一次 `describeCell`,结果存进 state,渲染只读这个 state;
   - (b) 改契约:把 TSDoc 改成如实描述(例如「选中格渲染时也会被问;宿主必须让它是纯读取」),并在正文写明唯一宿主 `ObjectGrid` 的 `describeCell`(`plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:1376`)在渲染里调用是安全的:`recordVerdict(...)` 与 `approvalLocks.isLocked(...)` 都只读缓存、不发请求、不 setState,`requestVerdicts()` 仍只在 `onCellSelect` 里调用。还要写明:选中后、裁决还没回来之前那几帧 `aria-readonly` 读到的是什么。
   选 (b) 时 `Clause-②: yes (widening)` 不变,在 changeset 的 widening 句里补上这条宿主契约的变化。

修完推新 head、CI 全绿后再报一次,我在新 head 上只核 delta。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `65b9199f95b7ca25ab1822e534472547bc1d767e`
Local-runs: none

Delta review over the PASS record 7076070602 at `2c776b47`. Inputs read: card #35689 body and every comment, the new one being the dev report 7077625407; PR #36332 comments, among them L1 REWORK 7076074435 and the final-head note 7077650269; the PR body at the new head (draft, base `main`, `Part of #35689`, 19 files); the net diff against merge-base `c448c615` (19 files, 454+ 14-), with the two rework commits `1733276c` and `6bc85294` read on their own and the merge `65b9199f` read for its resolution of `useRowApprovalLocks.ts` over main's batched lock read (#36295). Check-runs on the head: 62, all completed, 47 success, 15 skipped, 0 failure (the PR body still quotes 45 and 13 from an earlier read; the gate verdict is the same). Face: declaration. The rework adds `ui/packages/plugin-grid/**` to the tree, but no published schema and no governed path (Governed Surface Queue Guard success).

### ① Derived judgments

- S1, closed. `cellReadOnly` no longer calls `readOnlyReasonOf` (and with it `describeCell`) during render. The table asks `cellSelection.describeCell` for the selected cell in a layout effect keyed on the selected row, its column key and the provider value, and keeps the answer in `selectedHostReadOnly` (`data-table.tsx`, around 3732 to 3750). The render reads only that state. The unselected cells keep the table's own facts. The `GridCellSelection.describeCell` jsdoc ("asked when the reader acts on it, never per render") is unchanged, and the code keeps it for a host that holds its value steady. The one in-tree host does: `ObjectGrid` now memoises its `gridCellSelection` on what `describeCell` reads (`hostCellSelection`, `objectFields`, `objectSchema`, `objectName`, `perms`, `gridEditable`, `objectInlineEditable`, `approvalLocks`, `recordVerdict`, `pageRecordIds`, `t`). I checked that each of these keeps its identity across renders: `usePermissions` is one identity per context value, the safe-translation `t` is stable, `recordVerdict` and `approvalLocks` are memoised and change only when an answer lands, and `paginatedData` rows keep their identity through the slice. `canUpdate` now reads an inline `{ objectSchema, objectName, perms }` with the same three members as `affordanceSource`, so the verdict is the same and nothing is new on each render. `confirmCommit` and the chip opener read the latest closures through `latestCellHooks`, updated in a layout effect, and are only called from events. A pin asserts the ask count holds across three re-renders. Dev ablation A1 turns it red.
- S2, closed. `useRowApprovalLocks` now keeps an `answerSeq` state. It is bumped in the batched read's `finally` when at least one id answered and the answer map is still current, and again when an invalidation drops non-empty answers. `isLocked` depends on it, so the hook's returned value is new exactly when what `isLocked` reads changes. That value flows into the memo, then into a new provider value, and the table asks again. A lock that lands after selection therefore turns the selected cell's `aria-readonly` on, or off when the `approval_status` stand-in was wrong, without the reader moving. Both directions are pinned in `ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx` with a gated lock read, and dev ablation A2 turns both red. The S2 edit was re-applied over #36295 inside the merge commit, and the resolution reads correctly: a read that fails sets no bump, which is right because `isLocked` treats asking and unanswered alike. The changeset claim that an update verdict landing later is also said at once holds too, because `useRecordCrudVerdicts` returns a new memoised value whenever `verdicts` changes.
- N1, closed. The comment now says a tap on a mouse-drawn button does nothing. `pressedByRef` is read once and cleared by the click, and a later assistive-tech click edits (pinned; ablation A3). One residual edge remains: a touch press that never produces a click (a pointercancel on scroll) leaves the ref set until the next click. It does not block.
- N2, closed. Names are joined with the pack's `validation.formInvalidJoiner`. That key exists in all eleven packs (`、` in ja, zh-Hans and zh-Hant; `، ` in ar), and the table's private fallback table carries its English value. A header-less column is never named by its key. If no headed column saved, the region says `table.cellSaved` ("Saved"), an existing key. No new pack key comes from this.
- R1 (nit, new): the rework makes the provider value's identity part of the `describeCell` contract. The table now asks again on every new `cellSelection` value and on every re-read selected row. A third-party host that builds its value inline each render would get one ask per render of the selected cell, after commit. The published jsdoc does not tell a host this. The changeset says it ("again only when the row is re-read or the host hands a new value"), and the in-tree host is memoised, so nothing is wrong today. One clause on `describeCell` or `GridCellSelectionProvider` ("asked again when the value or the selected row changes; keep the value stable") would make the jsdoc complete. Not required for this head.
- No other new surface. The provider value becomes a memo, the hook gains a state, and the table gains one state and one layout effect, so no export of `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` (it does not export `useRowApprovalLocks`) or `@object-ui/i18n` changes shape. The hook's returned members (`probe`, `isLocked`, `settling`) are unchanged. Only their identity now tracks the answers.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/35689-inline-edit-a11y.md` now bumps `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid` as patch. The third bump is owed and right: the rework moves source in `plugin-grid` (`ObjectGrid.tsx`, `useRowApprovalLocks.ts`) and nothing published from it widens or narrows. These are still exactly the packages the diff moves.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` appear line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset body. The rework does not change the declaration. It adds no pack key: it reuses `validation.formInvalidJoiner` and `table.cellSaved`. It narrows no accept set and removes or renames no export. The widening sentence still names only `table.cellSavedAnnouncement`, which is still the one new key. The undeclared host-facing semantic change S1 named at the prior head is gone, because the contract is kept rather than amended. R1 is a documentation completeness point, not a narrowing. No `(narrowing)` arm, no BREAKING banner and no ADR-0087 disposition are owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in 7077625407.
- `out_of_scope_findings` (`carrier: none`), answered. (a) The staged click-to-edit model (no `cellSelection`, `singleClickEdit` true) still edits in place on a touch tap. That is true on main, unchanged here, outside slice A, and stated in the PR's acceptance notes. Accepted. (b) The `ObjectGrid` memo has no pin on its own ask count. Accepted, because the table-level pin and the two lock pins cover the observable behaviour. (c) The statement about #36357 is stale; see the semantic watch below.
- Deviations (1) to (4): (1), merging main for the #36295 conflict, is verified above. (4), keeping the TSDoc and memoising the host, is the L1's option (a) and is right. (2) and (3) are attribution process outside this contract.
- N3 (carried, nit): seat 7's claim 7075957369 was not amended. Its `File surface:` still reads `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/` and i18n keys. The rework now does touch plugin-grid, but `ui/packages/components/**` (data-table and its three tests) is still outside the claim's literal surface. The dev report lists the final 19-file surface "for the claim amendment". The seat should amend the claim, or accept the report as the amendment. PR-body guards are green.
- Semantic watch, #36357 (another thread, head `1c2a16b9`, open). The dev report and the PR body measured #36357 at `d084d3db` and wrote that it touches only `plugin-view`. That is stale. At `1c2a16b9`, #36357 edits `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: it renames the prop to `cellSelectionProp`, adds `hostCellSelection = cellSelectionProp ?? inlineEditable`, and sets `singleClickEdit: true` unconditionally. It also edits `ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx`, a file this PR also edits, where `renderGrid` passes `cellSelection` through instead of `cellSelection || undefined`. The two heads touch different hunks, and `git merge-tree` of `65b9199f` with `1c2a16b9` is clean with no conflicting path. The semantics are compatible. #36357 still defines `hostCellSelection` as a boolean before this PR's memo, which keeps it in its dependency list, so the memo stays stable. It makes every grid that renders editable select-first, so this PR's touch guard, its `aria-readonly` and its live region extend to authored object-grids and ObjectView grids, and "a touch never edits in place" holds for every grid that renders editable once both land. The one remaining exception is a host passing `cellSelection={false}` explicitly, which keeps the staged model and edits on a touch tap. No in-tree host on main passes `false`. #36357's own record should note this as the residual of the touch rule. The claim's `Serial constraints cleared` line ("overlap-check clean against every open PR head sharing a file") predates #36357's ObjectGrid edit. Whichever PR lands second should re-run overlap-check against the other's head.
- Not tested on a real device: VoiceOver/NVDA output and a real iPad. Unchanged from the prior record. This stays with the L1 and L2 seats or a dogfood pass.
- SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5): the rework adds no data access. The lock read's batching is main's (#36295). The rework adds only a re-render counter over it and no id materialisation or in-app join. No finding.

L1 REWORK(增量)· head `65b9199f95b7ca25ab1822e534472547bc1d767e` · 2026-11-22T10:54Z

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:和上一轮一样:列表表格里只读的格子会告诉读屏软件「只读」,保存结果在一个固定的播报区域里说出来,手指点没选中的格子不会就地编辑。本轮新增两点:同时保存的几格按当地语言的顿号或逗号连起来读;选中一格后,审批锁或编辑权限的结果晚到时,这一格的「只读」会立刻跟着更新。
- 为什么做:卡 #35689 的 A 部分;本轮执行我上次 REWORK 的补救方案 (a)。
- 出错会怎样:最多是读屏软件读错一格是否只读,或者播报文字不准;不碰数据,可以撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:REWORK,只有一项,只改文字:`describeCell` 的 TSDoc 还要补一句宿主须知。实现本身我读下来是对的。

## 要改的(1 项)

1. **`GridCellSelection.describeCell` 的 TSDoc 要写明表格什么时候问它。** 现在 `gridCellSelection.tsx:112` 还写着 "asked when the reader acts on it, never per render"。本轮的实现会在一格变成选中时问一次,之后在这一行被重读、或者宿主传进一个新的 `GridCellSelection` 值时再问(`data-table.tsx` 里那个 `useLayoutEffect`,依赖是 `[selectedRow, selectedColumnKey, cellSelection]`)。新用例「a new host value is asked again」把这一点钉成了约定。所以,如果宿主每次渲染都传一个新对象,它就会每次渲染都被问一次,TSDoc 里的「never per render」对这样的宿主就不成立。`ObjectGrid` 用 `useMemo` 保持这个值稳定,所以它没问题;但这个接口是 `@object-ui/components` 发布出去的,别的宿主只能读 TSDoc。请把这一行改成如实的说法,例如:「asked as a cell becomes selected and when the reader acts on it, and again when the selected row is re-read or the host hands a new value — keep the value stable across renders, or it is asked on each one」。changeset 的 Read-only cells 那条已经写了这层意思,不用改;`Clause-②: yes (widening)` 不变。只改文字,我做增量审核时只核这一行加 CI。
